prerequisites: It is recommended to have taken basic mathematics, physics, and fluid mechanics courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems.
Introduction of Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems, calculation of force, pressure, flow rate, and stroke in Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems.
Introduction of Hydraulic and Pneumatic circuit elements and information about their functions.
Hydraulic and Pneumatic circuit symbols and circuit design and application.
Hydraulic and Pneumatic circuit design and industrial applications.
Hydraulic and Pneumatic circuit design and industrial applications.
Electro-Hydraulic or Electro-Pneumatic circuit design and industrial applications.

syllabus_topics: Definition of Hydraulics and Pneumatic systems, historical development, areas of use
Basic concepts of Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems
Basic principles of Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems, hydraulic energy, pneumatic energy conversions
Hydraulic and Pneumatic Circuit Symbols, Hydraulic reservoir, pump, cylinders and motors
Pressure control valves, Directional control valves, flow control valves Hydraulic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
Pneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
SHORT EXAM APPLICATION Pneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
Pneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
SHORT EXAM APPLICATION Pneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
Pneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
Electropneumatic and Electrohydraulic circuit elements, Electropneumatic circuit design, drawing, reading and application
